starter_pack.name: The Ancient Wonder
starter_pack.title: Quest: Stonehenge
starter_pack.poem:
Begin where the tidal river meets the sea,
Where bridges span and history flows free.
In the capital where towers stand tall,
Where royal crowns mark passing times for all.

Journey west where the chalk hills rise,
Through counties where ancient wisdom lies.
Seek the plain where armies once trained,
Where prehistoric mysteries remained.

From the city of Roman baths, travel south and east,
Where Neolithic builders never ceased.
Find where standing sentinels align,
With solstice sun and stars divine.
Eight miles north of the cathedral spire,
Where druids' dreams set hearts afire.
hints: This region has a long tradition of creating ceremonial spaces in open landscapes
Ancient peoples here built structures that connected them to the natural world around them
The area is known for prehistoric monuments that mark significant places in the landscape

starter_pack.name: The Lost Citadel
starter_pack.title: Quest: Machu Picchu
starter_pack.poem:
Start where the empire's heart once beat,
At eleven thousand feet where cultures meet.
In the city where conquistadors found gold,
Where Incan walls their stories told.

Follow the blessed valley's winding way,
Where terraced fields still greet the day.
Journey northwest along the river's course,
Where condors soar with natural force.

Climb beyond the town where waters warm,
Where mountain paths show no relenting.
Seek the ridge between two peaks that guard,
The citadel where history's scarred.
At eight thousand feet, the lost city waits,
Where twin summits create the gates.
hints: This civilization mastered agriculture on steep mountain slopes using terraced farming techniques
The culture excelled at building in high-altitude environments with sophisticated stone masonry
Ancient peoples here created settlements that harmonized with dramatic natural landscapes

starter_pack.name: The Mighty Monument
starter_pack.title: Quest: Taj Mahal
starter_pack.poem:
Begin where seven cities once stood,
The capital where empires understood.
Where the fortress of scarlet guards the old,
And Mughal stories are still told.

Travel southeast on the sacred river's path,
Where Ganges' sister flows its math.
Journey to the city of the red stone,
Where marble dreams are widely known.

From the stronghold of crimson hue,
Look across where gardens grew.
Follow the river's eastern shore,
Where symmetry and beauty soar.
Find the mausoleum of purest white,
Reflected in the water's light.
hints: This region has a rich tradition of creating monuments that blend architectural beauty with deep emotional meaning
The culture is known for exquisite marble craftsmanship and symmetrical design principles
Historical love stories have inspired some of the world's most celebrated architectural achievements here

starter_pack.name: The Eternal Feat
starter_pack.title: Quest: Great Pyramid of Giza
starter_pack.poem:
Start where the river splits in two,
In the city where minarets pierce the blue.
Where the fortress stands on high,
And ancient markets never die.

Cross the life-giving river's western side,
Where pharaohs' tombs in grandeur hide.
Journey to the plateau of three,
Where pyramids reach eternally.

From the watcher with human visage,
Navigate through time and space.
Seek the largest, oldest of the three,
Built for the pharaoh of eternity.
On the plateau's highest ground,
Where ancient mysteries are found.
hints: This ancient civilization developed advanced techniques for constructing monumental structures
The culture perfected methods of preserving and honoring their rulers through grand architectural projects
This region is renowned for creating some of humanity's earliest and most enduring architectural marvels

starter_pack.name: The Modern Marvel
starter_pack.title: Quest: Eiffel Tower
starter_pack.poem:
Begin at the cathedral with gargoyles and rose,
On the island where the city arose.
Where Gothic spires touch the sky,
And legends of the bell-ringer never die.

Cross the river to the Left Bank's side,
Where culture and history coincide.
Journey west along the water's flow,
Past the palace where treasures glow.

Continue to the Field of Mars,
Where military parades left their scars.
Seek the iron lattice that pierces the sky,
Where an engineer's vision lies high.
At the park's northwestern edge you'll find,
The tower that captures every mind.
hints: This region has a strong tradition of celebrating engineering achievements through public monuments
The culture values innovation in materials and design, especially during periods of industrial advancement
Urban planning here often incorporates grand structures that become symbols of national identity
